## Personality

Patty's primary ambition is to lay eyes on the Sphinx at least once in her lifetime before she dies.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Confidences P8](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0008)_

## History

Patty inherited her home, Patty's Place, through her brother Aaron's will, having never set foot in [Europe](../codex/places.md#europe) or expected to travel there. Late in life, she and Miss [Maria](../character/maria.md) agreed to rent the house to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) for the upcoming school year, embarking on extensive travels shortly thereafter. The arrangements at Patty's Place went so well that the students learned they were permitted to stay for an additional year.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Place P12](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0012), [v3 ch.Place P18](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0018), [v3 ch.Place P30](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0030), [v3 ch.Place P32](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0032), [v3 ch.Place P47](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0047), [v3 ch.Place P59](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0059), +5 more_
